tasks.brief:
Enable background Web Push for the installed NOVA WhatsApp PWA at /whatsapp (iPhone, iOS 16.4+), so new inbound customer WhatsApp messages notify while the app is closed.

Owner 2026-11-16 01:08 Asia/Riyadh: asked to turn background notifications on («اه شغلها طبعا»), then assigned this to Claude on account ahmed m («خلي كلود ahmed. M يعملها»). Slot A only, Sonnet. Slot B stays disabled (do not touch DISABLE_SLOT_B).

CONTEXT — do not rewrite from scratch. UX406 already landed Web Push scaffolding on main:
- backend/src/inbox-push.js: GET /api/v1/inbox/history/push/key, POST subscribe / unsubscribe, RFC 8291/8292 encrypt + VAPID, notifyInbound + schedulePush(ctx.waitUntil). Subscriptions currently live in KV (wapush:…), not D1. tools/gen-vapid-keys.mjs already exists.
- schedulePush is already called from ingestDirect in backend/src/whatsapp-bridge.js.
- sw.js already has push + notificationclick handlers, but notificationclick opens '/#wa' (the sales home). Change the click target so it opens '/whatsapp?app=whatsapp#wa' or that specific chat. The SW scope must cover /whatsapp (today /sw.js is registered with default scope / — keep or adjust so the installed /whatsapp PWA still receives pushes).
- The list bell already requests permission and calls nSub(). When GET push/key returns enabled:false it toasts «إشعارات الخلفية لسه مش متفعلة على السيرفر. الصوت والعداد شغالين والصفحة مفتوحة.» Staging currently returns enabled:false because the VAPID Worker secrets are NOT set on nova-rx-api-staging (confirmed 2026-11-16; existing staging secret names do not include VAPID_*). In-app sound and the unread badge already work while the page is open.

WHAT TO DO:
1. Generate VAPID keys and store them ONLY as Worker secrets on staging worker nova-rx-api-staging. Secret names: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY (base64url, 65-byte uncompressed P-256 point), VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY (base64url, 32-byte d), optional VAPID_SUBJECT (mailto: or https:). NEVER commit, log, print, or put key values in the PR, tests, comments, or artifacts. Do not rotate or overwrite any existing secret. If you cannot write Worker secrets from the cloud agent, leave an operator note with the secret NAMES only (no values) and keep the feature disabled until those secrets exist; a follow-up staging deploy will put them.
2. Additive D1 migration for a push_subscriptions table (no DROP / TRUNCATE / DELETE FROM). Wire subscribe / unsubscribe + notify to D1 (KV may remain as a fallback; do not break existing tests). Keep the same history gate (pinless on staging/preview with a browser User-Agent).
3. On ingestDirect of an inbound customer message, send the push via ctx.waitUntil (already hooked — keep or fix). Title = customer name or number, body = short preview, click opens /whatsapp?app=whatsapp#wa or that chat. Delete subscriptions on HTTP 404/410.
4. SW push and notificationclick handlers with a scope covering /whatsapp.
5. The bell requests permission, subscribes, and shows on/off (icon or colour). Once the server reports enabled:true, remove / never show the «الخلفية لسه مش متفعلة على السيرفر» toast. A short one-time tooltip or toast is fine for denied/unsupported only.
6. Rebuild the preview artifact: node tools/build-worker-artifact.mjs worker/live/nova-rx-preview.ux-406.js index.html worker/live/nova-rx-preview.ux-407.js and run node tests/unit/artifact-ux407.check.mjs (all PASS). Commit the artifact with the change.
7. Tests: unit tests for subscribe/unsubscribe, payload shaping, 404/410 deletion, and D1 (or existing KV) storage. Plus an e2e push to a Chromium test subscription ONLY (fake/local endpoint or the injectable NOVA_PUSH_FETCH; do not send to real customer devices or to WhatsApp). Playwright at 390×844 for the bell permission / subscribe / on-off path with fakes. Existing ux407 / ux408 / ux410 / ux413 tests must still pass.

RULES: no WhatsApp sends to customers, no test sends, do not touch WA_TOKEN, no destructive DB ops, nothing that costs money, never print or rotate secrets or the PIN, never call /register or /deregister, no production deploy (staging backend + preview artifact only; leave a note if a staging deploy is required for the secrets). Do not edit the cloud queue, workflows, or DISABLE_SLOT_B. Do not start UX402, UX403, UX329, SALE-05, or UX313 — they stay on hold.

Live app: https://nova-rx-preview.elsousypharmacy.workers.dev/whatsapp
API: https://nova-rx-api-staging.elsousypharmacy.workers.dev

These three are TOP PRIORITY — fix H–J first (together with A–G), then the earlier review items. Do not send any WhatsApp message. H. The top edge / header bar looks odd on iPhone (clock, signal and battery collide with a squeezed tabs strip and a second bar). A design-lead review of the live preview artifact ux-407 (https://nova-rx-preview.elsousypharmacy.workers.dev, 390×844, 2026-11-15 17:32 Asia/Riyadh) compared the conversations screen to WhatsApp iOS and to the pharmacy dashboard Today page. Fix these defects, highest first (each is a concrete visual bug, not a suggestion):

1. Unread badges never appear on history chats: a conversation whose last message is from the customer (and that has not been opened) shows no green badge, the name stays regular, and the time stays grey. WhatsApp iOS: green count badge, bold name, green time. Today the list of «سارة علي» / «منى حسن» is indistinguishable from a read chat. The current seen-baseline (first open of the screen marks everything already there as read) is why this happens — wait-for-reply chats must still show as unread.

2. Sticky date chips stack and cover messages: «أمس» and «اليوم» stick to the same top offset and overlap each other and the photo caption. WhatsApp shows only one date chip, centered, and the sticky chip is a single current-day pill.

3. Bubble tails are on the wrong corner: a tail is drawn at the TOP of the FIRST bubble in a same-direction run (border-top-left/right radius 0 + 8×13 clip). WhatsApp iOS puts the tail at the BOTTOM of the LAST bubble in the group, on the screen-edge side.

4. Every outgoing bubble is labelled «الصيدلي» (and bot rows «البوت») in cyan above the text. In a 1-to-1 WhatsApp chat your own messages have no sender name — remove those labels from the bubble (the prefix «رد الصيدلي:» is already stripped).

5. In-bubble images are force-cropped to a square (min(260px, 62vw) with object-fit:cover), so a tall prescription photo loses the top and bottom. WhatsApp keeps the image’s aspect ratio, rounded corners, max-width ~70% of the thread.

6. Composer is WhatsApp Web, not iOS: a green send button is always visible on the left, and the pill always contains emoji + clip + mic (the last three are even disabled «قريباً» yet still take space). WhatsApp iOS: a + button outside the field, a camera inside the field when it is empty, and the mic button becoming Send only once there is text.

7. Time and ticks sit on the inline-end of the bubble, which under dir=rtl is the LEFT. WhatsApp keeps time + ✓ / ✓✓ / blue ✓✓ in the bottom-RIGHT corner of the bubble even in Arabic.

8. Chat header is undersized and the wrong metadata: the name is 14px (the list uses 17px), the subtitle is «9 رسالة · آخر نشاط 17:18», and there are no call/video actions. WhatsApp iOS: ~17px name, status line «متصل / آخر ظهور», avatar tight against the back chevron, call and video on the trailing side.

9. The image lightbox background is rgba(5,6,8,0.96) so the chat chrome (nav, header, composer) shows through. Use a solid black full-screen overlay like WhatsApp iOS, with only the photo, close, and download on top.

10. Chat list chrome: a ▾ overflow chevron is visible on every row, and the title «المحادثات» is duplicated («المحادثات» + «المحادثات (4)»). WhatsApp has one large title and no per-row chevron (the row itself is the control).

11. Bubble type is 14.2px / 19px with 10px corners — smaller and tighter than WhatsApp iOS (~17px, ~16px radius) and tighter than the Today page typography. Increase body size and corner radius, and keep dark-mode contrast (outgoing text and ticks must stay clearly readable on the green bubble).

12. List preview for an image shows the raw placeholder «[صورة]» (منى حسن). WhatsApp (and UX405) show a photo glyph + the word «صورة», plus the caption when there is one. Run last-message text through previewText, including bracket placeholders.

No deploy, no merge, no production, no live customer messages. Rebuild or include a preview artifact so the review frames can be re-captured.

Cover: unread badge + bold name + green time on an unopened history chat whose last message is inbound; a single non-overlapping date chip; tails on the last bubble of a run, bottom edge; no «الصيدلي»/«البوت» label on outgoing 1:1 bubbles; image bubbles keep aspect ratio (no square crop); composer layout (send only when there is text; no always-on send); time+ticks in the bottom-right of the bubble; lightbox solid black and full-viewport; list preview «صورة» not «[صورة]». Record exact results.

tasks.title: Professional UX review: smoothness, fewest clicks, practical pro UI + fix tasks
tasks.brief: Professional UX review (read-only audit, then follow-up fix tasks). Goal from owner Ahmed: find every flaw and deliver the BEST user experience for a pharmacist using the app all day: smooth, fewest clicks, practical, professional interface. Serve the CURRENT repo frontend locally (it already includes UX1-UX6 fixes; e.g. `npx http-server` on the frontend dir, or use worker/live/nova-rx-preview.ux-fixes1.js via `npx wrangler dev --local` if simpler) — do NOT hit the live server for writes. Write tools/qa/ux-pro-audit.mjs (Playwright headless Chromium; `npm ci && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`), desktop 1366x768 and mobile 390x844. Walk real end-to-end pharmacist journeys with fake data: quick sale (search by name/barcode, add qty, discount, pay cash/card, print/sticker), return, purchase/receiving, stock lookup + low-stock, customer debt payment, prescription/chronic patient, daily report, settings. For each journey record: number of clicks/taps and keystrokes, time-to-complete, screen transitions, any dead ends, confusing labels, missing keyboard shortcuts (Enter/F-keys/barcode focus), missing confirmations or too many confirmations, slow interactions (measure INP/long tasks, first load, screen switch time), layout jank (CLS), inconsistent spacing/colours/buttons/typography, RTL issues, empty/error/loading states, accessibility (contrast, focus, tap target >=44px). Compare against best-practice POS UX and propose the ideal flow per journey with a target click count. Write .nova/qa/ux-pro-report.md in Arabic: executive summary, per-journey table (الرحلة | الكليكات الحالية | المستهدف | المشاكل | الحل), prioritized findings (عالية/متوسطة/منخفضة) with screenshots in .nova/qa/ux-pro/ (max ~40 small PNGs), performance numbers. Then write .nova/inbox/ux-pro.json = {"tasks":[...]} with one fix task per high/medium finding (group related, max 20), ids starting at UX9 (UX9, UX10, …), each {id, phase:10, title, brief, acceptance, after:[]} — frontend only, small, exact files + test to add (tests/unit or tests/ux, include click-count assertions for improved journeys), preserve Black Edition Arabic RTL, backend frozen, no deploys; set `after` only where a task truly builds on another. LAST item: a task (next UX id) that rebuilds the live Worker artifact worker/live/nova-rx-preview.ux-pro1.js from the repo frontend like UX7 did, after = all other new UX ids, must NOT deploy. Do not edit .nova/cloud-queue.json. Commit script, screenshots, report, inbox file on this branch.

tasks.title: Continuous QA loop: periodic Claude audit -> auto fixes -> auto preview deploy
tasks.brief: Owner Ahmed wants the Claude accounts to keep inspecting NOVA Rx on their own, find flaws, fix them and ship them automatically, so problems are caught before customers hit them. Build it fully on GitHub Actions (Nova must not need to wake up). 1) New workflow .github/workflows/qa-loop.yml: cron every 4 hours + workflow_dispatch, runs new .nova/qa_loop.py. 2) qa_loop.py: if the queue (.nova/cloud-queue.json) has any task with source starting 'inbox/qa-loop' that is not done/done_noop/failed, do nothing (one cycle at a time). Otherwise compute next = (highest numeric UX id in queue and inbox)+1, rotate a focus area from a fixed list (quick sale & barcode; returns & refunds; purchasing & receiving; inventory, expiry & shortages; customers, debts & chronic refill; reports & shift close; settings & permissions; mobile layout; keyboard & accessibility; performance; Arabic copy & RTL; errors, offline & edge cases), and commit .nova/inbox/qa-loop-<next>.json with ONE audit task id UX<next> whose brief: audit the CURRENT repo frontend locally with Playwright (desktop 1366x768 + mobile 390x844, fake data, no live writes), focus on that area plus a quick smoke of all main journeys, read all previous .nova/qa/*report*.md to avoid duplicates, write .nova/qa/qa-loop-<next>.md (Arabic, short) with screenshots in .nova/qa/qa-loop-<next>/ (max 15), then write .nova/inbox/qa-loop-<next>-fixes.json with at most 8 small frontend-only fix tasks (ids UX<next+1>..UX<next+8>, tests required, Black Edition Arabic RTL preserved, backend frozen, no deploy) plus, ONLY if there are fixes, a final task titled exactly 'Build worker/live/nova-rx-preview.qa-<next>.js (qa-loop, no deploy)' with after = all its fix ids, rebuilding the artifact from the latest worker/live artifact the same way UX80 did. If nothing high/medium is found, write the report only. Then trigger cloud-scheduler. Keep the queue file untouched (inbox only). 3) Auto preview deploy: in .nova/cloud_scheduler.py, when a task whose title starts with 'Build worker/live/nova-rx-preview.qa-' becomes done and its artifact exists on main and was not deployed yet, dispatch the existing guarded deploy-worker.yml for that artifact to nova-rx-preview only (dry run then real if the workflow supports it, pre-deploy tests, record previous Cloudflare version id, post-deploy smoke: HTTP 200, /emergency/stock.json, search works; auto-rollback to previous version on failure), record deployed version in the task. Never deploy production, nova-rx-api-staging, GATE-17; never apply migrations. 4) Update docs/ops with how to pause the loop (repo variable QA_LOOP_DISABLED=true makes qa_loop.py exit). Add unit tests for qa_loop.py id/focus/one-at-a-time logic and for the deploy trigger.
tasks.acceptance: qa-loop.yml + qa_loop.py create one audit cycle at a time every 4h; audit tasks produce fix tasks + qa artifact build; scheduler auto-deploys qa artifacts to nova-rx-preview with smoke + auto-rollback; QA_LOOP_DISABLED pause switch; tests pass; CI green.

tasks.title: Fix WhatsApp header icon opening 404 blank page
tasks.brief:
Bug (Ahmed): on live nova-rx-preview (ux-pro4, version 3bc9277a, UX81 / PR #367) clicking the top-bar WhatsApp icon (#novaWaBtn) opens a blank white page that says "Not found".

Root cause: UX81 open() does `var t=document.getElementById('novaInboxTab'); if(t){t.click();return} location.href='integrations/whatsapp/inbox.html'`. #novaInboxTab is created only after an external script loads (`s.src='unified-inbox.js'` then init()). The preview Worker is a single bundled artifact and does not serve unified-inbox.js or integrations/whatsapp/inbox.html. Confirmed live: both URLs return HTTP 404, Content-Type text/plain, body exactly `Not found` (9 bytes). The tab is never inserted, the click falls back to a full-page navigation, and the Worker 404 is the white page.

Fix: clicking #novaWaBtn must open the in-app المحادثات (conversations) screen via SPA navigation (activate the المحادثات tab / show #novaInboxView). No location.href, no full-page navigation, no 404. Do not depend on fetching unified-inbox.js from a separate Worker path — inline or bundle the conversations view into the page/artifact so it works on nova-rx-preview. Add a test that clicking #novaWaBtn lands on the conversations view (#novaInboxView visible or #novaInboxTab active) and does not navigate to integrations/whatsapp/inbox.html or any 404. Rebuild the live artifact as worker/live/nova-rx-preview.ux-pro5.js (next name after ux-pro4) the same way UX80/UX81 did (tools/build-worker-artifact.mjs, markers test, node --check). No deploy (cloud tasks never deploy).
tasks.acceptance: Clicking the WhatsApp header icon shows the in-app conversations view; no 404 / blank 'Not found' page; tests pass including a click-lands-on-conversations test; ux-pro5 artifact built; no deploy.
